The woman turns away from the stove and then returns to stir the pan contents with a wooden spoon.
The host melts butter in a pan and adds chopped pancetta while stirring.
A cook adds ingredients to a pan containing sizzling meat and stirs with a green spatula.
A cook pours tomato sauce from a can into the pan and stirs with the green spatula.
A cook adds a white substance from a small bowl into red sauce and whisks it vigorously.
Pasta is added to red sauce, mixed, and then poured onto a floral serving plate.
